nodes.name: full-product-audit.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Playwright E2E audit spec that validates every major surface in the Waggle app shell by opening apps via the dock and asserting visible text and UI state across 300+ lines of test scenarios.

nodes.name: full-wiring-audit.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Large Playwright E2E spec that audits all navigation wiring across sidebar views and collects console errors, verifying that every route and section loads without runtime failures.

nodes.name: light-mode-polish.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E spec focused on validating light-mode theme polishing — seeds fresh-boot light mode state and checks WCAG contrast ratios using luminance calculations.

nodes.name: live-chat-flow.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E spec that exercises the live chat agent interaction flow, navigating to the desktop workspace and testing message sending and agent response rendering.

nodes.name: phase-ab-verification.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E spec verifying Phase A and B feature correctness, navigating through dock-based app launch flows and asserting expected UI state for warm-hive redesign phases.

nodes.name: phase8-visual.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright visual regression spec for Phase 8 of the warm-hive redesign — sets themes, navigates to multiple views, and captures stable screenshots for visual comparison across dark and light modes.

nodes.name: polish-verification.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E spec verifying UI polish across tier states — skips onboarding, sets the user tier via API, and asserts the app shell and feature gating display correctly.

nodes.name: power-user-stress.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright stress-test spec simulating rapid power-user interactions — dispatches keyboard events, rapid navigation across views, and verifies no console errors or crashes under load.

nodes.name: room-parallel-agents.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E spec testing the Room multi-agent surface — installs an SSE mock to simulate parallel agent streams, then verifies the Room UI renders agent progress and results correctly.

nodes.name: spawn-agent-flow.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E spec validating the spawn-agent flow — sets up a fresh desktop page and exercises the agent spawning UI including model selection and task submission.

nodes.name: team-server.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E spec testing team-tier server API endpoints and multi-user collaboration features, asserting correct access-gating for TEAMS-tier routes.

nodes.name: user-behavior.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Large Playwright E2E spec simulating comprehensive user behavioral journeys — covers persona switching, memory save/search/count via API helpers, and validates the full interaction lifecycle across 1000+ lines.

nodes.name: user-journeys.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E spec covering critical user journeys end-to-end — onboarding, workspace navigation, keyboard shortcut dispatch, and cross-view workflows.

nodes.name: waggle-complete.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Most comprehensive Playwright E2E spec covering the complete Waggle product — exercises all major surfaces including chat, memory, agents, skills, and settings in a single mega-suite exceeding 1000 lines.

nodes.name: hive-950-token-guard.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit test that guards against accidental re-introduction of the deprecated hive-950 design token — scans the source tree for any file containing the literal `hive-950` string and fails if found.

nodes.name: login-flow.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Short Playwright E2E spec verifying the login and authentication flow — checks that the app routes unauthenticated users correctly and that login surfaces appear as expected.

nodes.name: oss-subtree-split.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit test auditing the OSS subtree split integrity — verifies that proprietary files (vault.ts, compliance/, etc.) are absent from the hive-mind-* packages and that the split script's abort guard is in place.

nodes.name: placeholder-audit.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit test scanning the codebase for unresolved placeholder strings (e.g., TODO, FIXME, placeholder text in UI) to prevent shipping incomplete copy to production.

nodes.name: skill-loader.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest unit test for the sidecar SkillLoader — tests loading, parsing, and validating skill frontmatter from the skills directory, verifying that skills are correctly discovered and enumerated.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the vision-based E2E testing harness — explains the two-phase capture/judge workflow using Playwright screenshots and an LLM vision judge workflow, including the rubric and current status.

nodes.name: r2-uat-mega.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Large Playwright visual UAT spec covering the R2 warm-hive redesign — iterates through all navigation views in both dark and light modes, capturing screenshots for visual regression comparison.

nodes.name: views.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright visual spec that captures screenshots of all navigation view states in dark and light themes for visual regression testing of the Waggle app shell.

nodes.name: vitest.setup.ts
nodes.summary: Root Vitest test setup file — configures global test environment, mocks, and shared fixtures used across all unit and integration test suites in the monorepo.

nodes.name: Waggle_Competitive_Intelligence_Full_Landscape_March_2026.docx
nodes.summary: Competitive intelligence document analyzing the full AI workspace and agent platform landscape as of March 2026, used for product positioning and strategic decision-making.
